name: Deep Forest Hermit
oracle_text:
Vanishing 3 (This creature enters with three time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter from it. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.)
When this creature enters, create four 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens.
Squirrels you control get +1/+1.
blocked_sentences: Vanishing 3 (This creature enters with three time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter from it. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.)

needs.what: Vanishing N (702.63): enters with N time counters; at the beginning of your upkeep remove a time counter; a separate triggered ability fires when the last time counter is removed and sacrifices the permanent
needs.why_existing_wont_do: vanishing is not in keywords. The enters-with-counters half is expressible via the self_enters_with_counters replacement and the upkeep removal via an upkeep trigger with remove_counters, but there is no trigger_event for a counter being removed (only counter_placed), so "When the last is removed, sacrifice it" can only be approximated by an inline if-zero-then-sacrifice inside the upkeep trigger, which is not the separate trigger the rules describe
